@client.event

    user_prompt = message.content[1:].strip()
    if not user_prompt:
        await message.channel.send("⚡ Hey! Ask me something after the `!`.")
        return

    # guard for private‑info requests
    sensitive_keywords = ["password", "ip", "credential", "location"]
    if any(word in user_prompt.lower() for word in sensitive_keywords):
        await message.channel.send(
            "I don’t have access to private server credentials, but I’ve logged this message so he can send it over as soon as he’s back! 💬✨"
        )
        return

            model="gpt-4o-mini",

                {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt}
            ],
            max_tokens=150,
            temperature=0.8,
